overview: The commission approved various traffic safety and parking requests, including a new three-way stop, crosswalk daylighting on High Street, and multiple accessible parking spaces near business districts and the Green Line Extension.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the September 12, 2023, meeting.

items.title: Handicapped Parking Space: 3 Toro Avenue
items.summary: Approved a request for a residential handicapped parking space at 3 Toro Avenue.

items.title: Three-Way Stop: Bowen Street and Dexter Street
items.summary: Approved a request to convert the intersection of Bowen and Dexter Streets into a three-way stop to improve safety following several collisions.

items.title: Main Street Accessible Parking Spaces
items.summary: Approved the installation of two accessible parking spaces near 387 Main Street and the Yale Street lot to support nearby businesses.

items.title: High Street Daylighting Request
items.summary: Approved a request to prohibit parking 20 feet east of the crosswalk at 190 High Street to improve pedestrian visibility and safety.

items.title: Ross Street Parking Variance
items.summary: Approved a permanent parking variance for one vehicle on Ross Street for a resident of 372 Riverside Avenue.

items.title: Logan Avenue Commercial Vehicle Variance
items.summary: Approved an overnight parking variance for an unlettered commercial pickup truck at 47 Logan Avenue.

items.title: Boston Avenue GLX Station Accessibility
items.summary: Confirmed the positioning of two accessible parking spaces and a ride-share zone near the Boston Avenue Green Line Extension station.

items.title: Public Participation and Other Business
items.summary: The commission addressed public concerns regarding crosswalk safety at South and Main Streets and provided clarification on driveway parking clearances.
